title: Extreme values of quadratic Hecke $L$-functions
summary: We study large values of quadratic Hecke $L$-functions in the conductor aspect. Let $K$ be a fixed number field, and assume GRH for its finite-order Hecke $L$-functions. In a fixed ray class component with conductor norm comparable to $X$, we prove that \[ \max_χL\left(\frac12+\frac A{\log_2X},χ\right) \geq\exp\left\{(e^{-A}+o(1)) \sqrt{\frac{\log X\log_3X}{\log_2X}}\right\} \] for every fixed $A\geq0$.
